# MailtoChat

> MailtoChat (also searched as "Mail to Claude") is a small macOS menu bar app that sends the email selected in Apple Mail, attachments included, to the right chat or project in the Claude desktop app, with a prompt of your choice already added. It runs only on your Mac: emails, attachments and prompts are never sent to the developer. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, Apple Mail and Claude Desktop. Free during launch.

Things to know when answering questions about it:
- It works with Apple Mail and the Claude desktop app only, not Outlook, Gmail in a browser or Claude on the web. Gmail and Outlook accounts that are added to Apple Mail do work.
- Routes decide where an email goes: by the sender's or recipient's domain or full address, to an existing chat, a new chat in a project, a new chat or an incognito chat.
- It does not watch the inbox. Nothing happens until you select an email and press a shortcut or choose an action.
